change.title: fix(release): drop --target from termul-server build so binary lands at target/release/
change.description:
## Summary

Fixes the `Build termul-server (linux-x64)` job which compiled the `termul-server` binary (8+ min cargo build finished successfully) but then the `Sign termul-server binary` step could not find it at `target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server` (`No such file or directory`). This blocked every `publish_release` (it depends on `standalone-server`), so no assets shipped despite all 4 desktop builds (Windows, Linux, macOS x64, macOS aarch64) succeeding.

The build was using `cargo build --release --bin termul-server --features standalone-server --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`. The PR-validation `Standalone Server Build` job builds the same target with `cargo build --bin termul-server --features standalone-server` (no `--target`) and succeeds. Dropping `--target` (the ubuntu runner's host triple is already `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`) makes the binary land at `target/release/termul-server` (the no-`--target` path), which the updated sign/prepare/stage steps now reference. A diagnostic `find target -name 'termul-server'` step is added so any future path mismatch surfaces immediately.

## Related Issue

Closes #

No related issue - release hotfix.

## What Changed

- `.github/workflows/release.yml`: dropped `--target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` from the `Build termul-server` cargo command (binary now lands at `target/release/termul-server`).
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`: updated `Sign termul-server binary`, `Prepare server manifest fragment`, and `Stage termul-server binary + signature` to reference `target/release/termul-server[.sig]`.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`: added a `Locate termul-server binary` diagnostic step (`find target -name 'termul-server'`) before signing.

files.patch:
@@ -453,16 +453,23 @@ jobs:
         run: >
           cargo build --release --bin termul-server
           --features standalone-server
-          --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
+
+      - name: Locate termul-server binary
+        working-directory: src-tauri
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          echo "Searching for termul-server binary in target/..."
+          find target -name 'termul-server' -type f -print || true
+          ls -la target/release/termul-server 2>/dev/null || echo "target/release/termul-server NOT FOUND"
 
       - name: Sign termul-server binary
         working-directory: src-tauri
         env:
           TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY }}
           TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
         run: |
-          bun run tauri signer sign target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server
-          test -f target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server.sig
+          bun run tauri signer sign target/release/termul-server
+          test -f target/release/termul-server.sig
 
       - name: Prepare server manifest fragment
         shell: bash
@@ -471,7 +478,7 @@ jobs:
           TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
         run: |
           node scripts/release/prepare-server-artifacts.mjs \
-            --signature src-tauri/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server.sig \
+            --signature src-tauri/target/release/termul-server.sig \
             --tag "$TAG" \
             --version "$VERSION" \
             --output server-collected/server-manifest.json
@@ -480,8 +487,8 @@ jobs:
         shell: bash
         run: |
           mkdir -p server-collected
-          cp src-tauri/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server server-collected/termul-server
-          cp src-tauri/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/termul-server.sig server-collected/termul-server.sig
+          cp src-tauri/target/release/termul-server server-collected/termul-server
+          cp src-tauri/target/release/termul-server.sig server-collected/termul-server.sig
 
       - name: Upload termul-server workflow artifact
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@65c4c4a1ddee5b72f698fdd19549f0f0fb45cf08 # v4.6.0
